Google daily and pages and all three Bing reports are built in from the exports of 21 Oct 2026. Paste CSV text or choose a file to replace any source or add the missing ones. Column names are matched loosely, so raw Search Console and Bing exports work as they are. Uploads stay in this browser only.

Google export: Web search, last 6 months (18 May to 19 Oct 2026), page filter “-support” (no support URLs appear). The pages tab holds Search Console’s 1,000-row maximum, about 84% of total impressions, so page shares are of that top 1,000. Impressions come from searchers in all countries. Bing export: 21 Apr to 18 Oct 2026, Microsoft Copilots and partners. The Bing page list has 4374 pages (query strings removed, www and non-www merged, one malformed URL skipped) and includes support pages; the Google export excludes them, so “Hide support pages” is on by default to keep the two comparable. The Bing daily totals above include support pages. The Bing queries report has 2387 rows (3 repaired, 1 skipped for broken quoting) and sums to about 430K citations, so it covers a subset of the citations in the daily totals.
